items.sentence: 搬家那天下午，朋友答应两点来，三点才出现。重箱子已经由邻居帮忙搬上楼了。朋友说既然东西都搬好了，他就明天再来。我请他先留下整理书架。搬完箱子不代表我不再需要帮助，更不代表他原来的安排没有影响。
items.py: bān jiā nà tiān xià wǔ , péng you dā yìng liǎng diǎn lái , sān diǎn cái chū xiàn . zhòng xiāng zi yǐ jīng yóu lín jū bāng máng bān shàng lóu le . péng you shuō jì rán dōng xi dōu bān hǎo le , tā jiù míng tiān zài lái . wǒ qǐng tā xiān liú xià zhěng lǐ shū jià . bān wán xiāng zi bù dài biǎo wǒ bù zài xū yào bāng zhù , gèng bù dài biǎo tā yuán lái de ān pái méi yǒu yǐng xiǎng .
items.en: My friend promised to help me move at two but arrived at three. A neighbour had carried the heavy boxes upstairs. My friend proposed coming tomorrow instead; I asked him to stay and organise the shelves. The completed move didn't erase the need for help or the effect of his lateness.

items.en: Don't rush to promise a bigger task. I first want to know why you didn't contact me last time, then plan this time. I don't want to discover another clash at the last moment.

items.sentence: 毕业后，我们没有每天联络。有时一个月才谈一次，也不总是讨论大事。这次她来出差，我们只吃了一顿晚饭，没有安排旅游。离开的时候她说，下次见面不用等到有什么特别的事。听到这句话，我反而放心了，不必每次都准备一个值得报告的好消息。
items.py: bì yè hòu , wǒ men méi yǒu měi tiān lián luò . yǒu shí yī gè yuè cái tán yī cì , yě bù zǒng shì tǎo lùn dà shì . zhè cì tā lái chū chāi , wǒ men zhǐ chī le yī dùn wǎn fàn , méi yǒu ān pái lǚ yóu . lí kāi de shí hou tā shuō , xià cì jiàn miàn bù yòng děng dào yǒu shén me tè bié de shì . tīng dào zhè jù huà , wǒ fǎn ér fàng xīn le , bù bì měi cì dōu zhǔn bèi yī gè zhí de bào gào de hǎo xiāo xī .
items.en: After graduating, we sometimes talk only once a month. During her work trip we just had dinner, with no sightseeing. She said we needn't wait for a special occasion next time. I was relieved that every meeting didn't need some good news to report.

items.py: wǒ chéng rèn nà jù huà shuō de tài kuài , ràng nǐ yǐ wéi yǐ jīng jué dìng le . shí jì zhǐ shì yī gè jiàn yì , hái děi wèn lìng wài liǎng gè rén . nǐ xiān bié tì wǒ xuān bù , wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shang què rèn yǐ hòu gěi nǐ xiāo xī .
items.en: I admit I spoke too quickly and made it sound decided. It was a suggestion; two other people still need asking. Don't announce it yet. I'll update you tonight.

items.sentence: 住在一起的朋友以前常替我决定周末的活动。我有一次说想安静待在家里，他以为我不满意我们的友谊。我们后来谈了一下，发现我希望保留自己的时间，而他只是担心我一个人会无聊。现在他会先问要不要参加，我也会明确回复，不让他一直猜。

items.en: My roommate used to choose our weekend activities. When I wanted a quiet day at home, he thought I was unhappy with our friendship. We talked: I wanted time for myself; he worried I'd be bored. Now he asks, and I answer clearly.

items.sentence: 朋友送我一本她喜欢的小说。我读了前几段，发现自己暂时读不下去，担心直接说会伤害她。后来她问我读得怎样，我说人物很有意思，但现在更想看短一点的文章。她笑着说自己第一次读也没读完。我才知道，珍惜礼物不等于必须喜欢每一页。
